result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on how many employees you have, whether you already use accounting software, and how much of the payroll administration you want automated.

If you're running a small business in the UK, I'd prioritise software that handles\:

- HMRC PAYE and Real Time Information (RTI) submissions.
- Tax, National Insurance and pension calculations.
- Workplace pension auto-enrolment.
- Payslips and year-end reporting.
- Holiday pay, statutory sick pay and maternity pay.
- Making payroll straightforward without needing an accountant to run it every month.

## My top UK payroll software recommendations

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Good for small and growing businesses.
- PAYE, National Insurance, RTI and workplace pensions.
- Employee records and payslips.
- Reported starting price: £12/month for up to five employees.

Best if you want a straightforward standalone payroll system.

[Sage Payroll website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/products/payroll/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay**

(Best payroll specialist)

- Strong payroll-specific functionality.
- Pension integrations and HMRC submissions.
- Particularly good if an accountant also manages payroll.
- Cloud pricing needs to be confirmed.

[BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Sage Payroll | CMM Accountancy, Inverness](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eV7r_Y7LhUUTC9Bu-F6y1eAfhaHXAB2YHguOKgyDONnXgZMuJ-Xf-NJS__sr2531iLivDglNRuay7jZ1VhHl-4B0ijG3RQj1i2keTM8q-3DlUqMCCoO-Ty09j6QnYlQVuoJ4IPeeIA855V7dXW_wjbHTU1JXVKkD4V58gLa3Z_3e4-DGBkjovBT4jhJ0NWAD?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

- Payroll linked to your bookkeeping.
- HMRC submissions and employee payslips.
- Workplace pension functionality.
- Particularly attractive if you already use Xero.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Good if your accounts are already in QuickBooks.
- Payroll and accounting information together.
- HMRC reporting and pension functionality.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![Moneysoft Payroll Manager User Reviews & Pricing For 2026 - BusinessFinancing.co.uk](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/7ksdOV7E-FuiXPxwB-8w5JZkSHtBcjkVxCJYbFrODk4PmznMHOmA4B-tBaxnYCFYD6Jp0kSAbnQXIsecvAn3rHv3L9eIJmTsQHps-CqLdeVCxq8PEavEP85m-O6tbVJZIUw1amDOLcBgiDPKuXotb0Z1X2mhBds1tgi1vwa-scPjVzxF5ozKfmnh-hP00M1w?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Moneysoft Payroll Manager**

(Best budget option)

- Excellent option for smaller employers.
- Straightforward payroll processing.
- Annual licence reported at around £95 plus VAT for up to 20 employees.
- Windows-based rather than a fully cloud-based solution.

[Moneysoft website](https://www.moneysoft.co.uk/)

These options are drawn from UK payroll comparisons for 2026. [www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[smallbusiness.co.uk](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[paydocs.co](https://paydocs.co/blog/uk-payroll-providers-compared?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## One important point

If you have fewer than 10 employees, HMRC also lists free recognised payroll software, including Basic PAYE Tools. It's worth considering if you want to keep costs down. [www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-payroll-software-that-is-recognised-by-hmrc?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

You can check the official list here: [HMRC-recognised payroll software](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-payroll-software-that-is-recognised-by-hmrc)\.

## Which would I choose?

My starting recommendation would be **Sage Payroll** for a typical small UK employer. If you're already using Xero or QuickBooks for your accounts, I'd lean towards using their payroll instead to avoid duplicate administration.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
